final_message:
Fixed. `LRUCache.get` in `src/lru.py` never marked a key as recently used, so a key you had just read could still be evicted first. It now moves the key to the most-recent position on every hit. All 5 tests pass, including `test_get_refreshes_recency`, which was the one failing.

You didn't say what "it" was, so I ran the tests and fixed the failure I found. If you meant something else, tell me what you saw.

I haven't committed anything.
